verdict.rationale: Thoropass documents control owners responsible for each control and lets the Roadmap be grouped by owner. Evidence requests support comments, attachments and status updates, and tasks can be assigned from a unified task view, which together give a basic first-party workflow for manually supplied evidence. The only documented reminders are for access reviews, which is an adjacent feature. Nothing shows due dates, renewal reminders or expiry tracking on manual evidence artifacts. Missing for 10: per-artifact owners (ownership is documented at control level), due dates on manual evidence, renewal reminders for recurring manual artifacts, expiry/staleness tracking of uploaded evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration.
